chapter: Dance and brass bands of Alice's youth
title: Brass bands in Mardi Gras parades and hand cymbals
summary: She recalls parade brass bands with cornets, flutes and drums, and cymbals held one in each hand.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Cornet. Do you remember anything about the bands in the Mardi Gras parades? Did they have a brass band or what?
Well, in the Mardi Gras parade it was more so a brass band, you know.
Even when you were a child, do you remember that? Oh, well, yes.
Or the... Then it was, they didn't have violin in the parade, no.
I wonder what kind of a band, that was way back. And when you were a child, they did have the brass band that marched with the...
Yes, they didn't have, it was brass band marching.
And what would they play? What instruments?
Well, a cornet and a flute.
Probably about the same as now, I guess.
Probably about the same as now, I'm sure. Would they have drums?
And the cymbals? Yeah. Would they have cymbals like this? Or would they hit... Big drum? I think they would.
And this, what's it called? Hand cymbals.
Yeah. Hand cymbals. And now today, they put the cymbals on the bass drum. Uh-huh. And he hits the bass drum with one hand. Did they do that then, do you remember?
No. Well, yes. It began to come, you know, as I grew. Yes. But before it was, they just like this. Just the two, one in each hand.
